programme.title: Power & S2 - "Tabb Firchau"
programme.desc: Tabb Firchau is a cameraman who co-founded Freefly systems to design and build camera stabilizers and unmanned aerial vehicles that were easy to operate.

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Shane Chen"
programme.desc: Shane Chen is an inventor. Or to use his own words, he is a “tinkerer” – a fellow who makes a living from molding mechanisms into quirky creations.

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Massoud Hassani"
programme.desc: Massoud Hassani has developed the mine kafon drone that could find and get rid of the landmines, fast and cheap.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Resurrecting Tasmanian Tigers"
programme.desc: Wiped off the face of the Earth by humans nearly a century ago, geneticists are now working on ressurecting the enigmatic Tasmanian Tiger.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Shark Family Tree"
programme.desc: Great white sharks are one of the most feared predators on Earth, and yet we know very little about them. Science is now revealing the mysteries of this perfect predator through evolutionary biology.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Recovering From Extinction"
programme.desc: How long does it take for life to rebound after a major mass extiction? Scientists in Svalbard dig through fossil clues for surprising revelations abour our Earth's history.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Miami Beach Underwater"
programme.desc: As scientific studies confirm sea level changes throught the globe, major coastal cities like Miami are now fighting back against these rising tides, before it's too late. Parts of Miami Beach are under serious threat, with major economic dangers.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Coffee Buzz"
programme.desc: More than 400 million cups of coffee are consumed in the United States alone each day, making it one of the hottest drinks - even when served cold. Experts reveal some of the surprising secrets that make your favorite coffees taste the way they do.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "African Animal Rescue"
programme.desc: The staff of South Africa's Manyoni Private Game Reserve passionately care for some of the world's most exotic and endangered wild animals. From treating elephant foot infections to testing cheetahs for tuberculosis, they never know what to expect.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "New Firefighting Tech"
programme.desc: Firefighters have relied on the same basic tools for decades. But former NASA engineer Mike Ralston hopes to change that with a new breed of emergency vehicle.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Modern Stone Age Family"
programme.desc: Food Anthropologist Dr. Bill Schindler is on an international quest to discover what we should eat. Hi and his family uncover ancient culinary practices and show how they can bring simplicity and good health to the modern kitchen.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Bridging the Gap"
programme.desc: Nathan battles strong winds on a big roofing job, Dave handles an easy lift, J.P. moves a hot tub, and Dan faces confusion on a bridge build.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Special Delivery"
programme.desc: Regional Crane’s new machine hits a hydraulic snag. Dave uses his downtime for repairs, and Brad helps clear a stand of pine trees.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "The Need for Speed"
programme.desc: Maxum Crane tackles a tight indoor lift, JP removes a 60-year-old fighter jet, and Brad and Nathan race to install farm machinery before a storm hits.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Son of a Sailor"
programme.desc: Dan and Francis pull boats for winter. Maxum replaces a ferry engine. Brad and Nathan face tricky container moves. J.P. finishes by greasing the boom.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Thrill Rides"
programme.desc: Explore the ultimate adrenaline rush – the world’s fastest and scariest thrill rides.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of McVitie's Biscuits"
programme.desc: The McVitie's factory in Carlisle, Cumbria, opens its doors to reveal how millions of the nation's favourite biscuits are made, 24 hours a day, in one of Britain's biggest factories and oldest biscuit factory in the world.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of the Heinz Factory"
programme.desc: From making fresh spaghetti and mixing the top-secret ingredients for sauce, to giant automated cranes and the latest robots, join today’s Heinz factory workers alongside tomorrow’s machines, making cans of household favourites.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "The Ocean’s Apex"
programme.desc: In this episode, we observe two of the ocean’s apex predators in the wild.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Wind"
programme.desc: In this episode, Philippe takes us inside one of the most powerful forces on Earth - wind.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Student Explorer"
programme.desc: In this episode, we reveal the winner of our third ever #StudentExplorer Contest.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Megafloods"
programme.desc: Witness the devastating destructive power unleashed by planet earth’s most valuable resource – water.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Constructions"
programme.desc: Discover the worst bridge collapses and tunnel fires in history.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Skateboards, Vacuum Cleaners and ATMs"
programme.desc: Skateboard, vacuum cleaner, ATM, car jack, digital projector, and multi-tool... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Treadmills, Turntables and Barbeques"
programme.desc: Treadmill, turntable, barbeque, outboard motor, pneumatic drill, ballpoint pen... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Cross Trainers, 3D Printers and Turnstiles"
programme.desc: Cross-trainer, 3D printer, food mixer, frozen yoghurt maker, turnstile and office chair... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Elevators, Gas Pumps and Air-Hockey Tables"
programme.sub-title: Elevators, Gas Pumps and Air-Hockey Tables
programme.desc: Elevator, gas pump, air-hockey table, wood chipper, deli meat slicer and dentist drill... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: The Ship Sinkers
programme.desc: What fate awaits ships that were once proud vessels at bay, but have now turned into floating junkyards? While one option is to cut them up for scrap, another alternative is to use them to bolster marine biodiversity by turning them into artificial reefs. The old naval ships are sunk to an underwater resting place by ship sinkers.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Extreme Wildfire Combat"
programme.desc: After record-setting conflagrations erupted in the region's prized forests, new tools using cutting-edge technology are being developed to help save property and lives.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Battleground Bosnia"
programme.desc: On the 3 March 1992, Bosnia Herzegovina gained its independence from Yugoslavia. Immediately, the Serb-led military units took over large slabs of land and suppressed the other ethnic groups.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Kashmir Powder Keg"
programme.desc: With Kashmir’s special status removed in early August 2019 and terrorist attacks plaguing the region since earlier in the year, the India/Pakistani border-conflict has escalated once more.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Secret War In Laos"
programme.desc: In efforts to remove the Communists, the US conducted a devastating military operation, making Laos the most bombed country per capita - ever. The Laos Civil War has often been called America’s “secret war.”

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Cold War In Central America"
programme.desc: In the 1980s, El Salvador and Nicaragua were fighting vicious civil wars that claimed killed at least 100,000, saw 8000 people disappear, and left hundreds of thousands displaced. Still spearheading a global fight against communism, the US engaged.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Desert War In Mali"
programme.desc: It is a deadly war in the desert, one we know barely anything about. Once the heart of the golden Mali Empire, home to the richest man of the 14th century, the northern town of Timbuktu has become the victim of political instability and terror.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Coups Detat"
programme.desc: An uncompromising show of power, the military coup is an age-old method to violently and often secretly topple governments and take control by force. This episode goes behind the scenes of some of the greatest coups in recent history.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "The Gaza Offensive"
programme.desc: A mixture of political frustration and violent challenges led to the Gaza Offensive in 2014. As so many times over the past 13 years, Israeli soldiers launched brutally into the streets of Gaza, leaving destruction and death in their wake.
